# Nelly Creative Studios

> Handcrafted fine jewelry by Nelly Mendoza-Mendoza. Rare gemstones, 22k gold, and platinum pieces designed and made in New York City.

Fine and custom jewelry studio in New York City. Pieces are handmade in 22k and 18k gold and platinum with natural diamonds and rare gemstones; many are one of a kind, and bespoke commissions are available. Prices are in USD. Contact the studio through the contact page to commission or enquire.

## Key pages

- [About Nelly Mendoza-Mendoza — Fine Jewelry Designer NYC](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/about): Meet Nelly Mendoza-Mendoza, fine jewelry designer based in New York City. GIA Graduate, former Tiffany & Co.
- [Bespoke Custom Fine Jewelry NYC](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/bespoke): Commission a custom bespoke jewelry piece crafted to your vision. Nelly Creative Studios designs and makes one-of-a-kind fine jewelry in New York City using…
- [Fine Jewelry Boutique — Necklaces, Earrings, Bracelets & Rings](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/boutique): Shop handcrafted fine jewelry featuring rare gemstones, 22k gold, diamonds, and platinum. Turquoise, aquamarine, jadeite and more.
- [Contact — Get in Touch](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/contact): Get in touch with Nelly Creative Studios for bespoke jewelry commissions, boutique enquiries, or general questions. Based in New York City.
- [FAQ — Fine Jewelry Questions Answered](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/faq): Answers to your questions about fine jewelry, bespoke commissions, gemstones, care, and purchasing from Nelly Creative Studios in New York City.
- [Gemstone Encyclopedia](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/gemstones): A complete guide to 47 of the world's most remarkable gemstones — their origins, properties, history, and the stories they carry.
- [The Jewelry Journal — Fine Jewelry Stories & Gemstone Guides](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal): Explore the Nelly Creative Studios jewelry journal. Stories on rare gemstones, ancient techniques like granulation, bespoke commissions, and…

## Journal

- [5 steps to picking out your engagement ring](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/5-steps-engagement-ring): The most important jewelry choice you'll make — after deciding who to marry. A complete guide from mood board to final fitting.
- [A Day in the Life of Nelly](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/a-day-in-the-life-of-nelly): Morning workouts, black coffee, late-night sketching, and the beautiful chaos of running a fine jewelry studio in New York City.
- [Aesthetics & Nature](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/aesthetics-and-nature): On flowers, stardust, carbon atoms, and why nature is the oldest and finest designer — seven lessons for anyone who creates.
- [No 01: Ambrosia — DEFINITELY not late to my own show!](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/ambrosia): Five years after a show cancelled by the pandemic, Nelly finally presents her first solo exhibition — food of the gods, and a team that made it magical.
- [Chaotic creative energy part i](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/chaotic-creative-energy): On quiet mornings, NYC chaos, 6am routines, and the art of making space for your best creative work in a city that never stops.
- [Creative Process at Work](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/creative-process-at-work): On constraints, goals, hyperfocus, and how designing jewelry converts chaotic creative energy into something proud and precise.
- [The Creation of Diamond Earrings: From Source to Design](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/diamond-creation): A quest for the perfect pink diamond — from late-night sketching to the miner's mindset, and why every piece must exist within the DNA of the work.
- [Dreams and Desires](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/dreams-and-desires): On Greek mythology, ivy league economics degrees, the fear of becoming a starving artist, and why creating jewelry makes Nelly feel alive.
- [Nelly's Guide to Finding Your Perfect Fit](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/finding-your-perfect-fit): Jewelry should feel effortless and natural — like you were born with it.
- [Fine jewelry for men: starter guide](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/fine-jewelry-for-men): Men love jewelry just as much. A fearless guide to gold necklaces, link bracelets, signet rings, and building a fine jewelry wardrobe.
- [First Day of Spring](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/first-day-of-spring): Blooming in Color — a living guide to favorite spring flowers, gathered at the Union Square Greenmarket. Ranunculus, tulips, and anemones.
- [Is Gold Jewelry a Good Investment?](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/is-gold-jewelry-a-good-investment): Gold is trading near record highs in 2026. Does that make gold jewelry a smart investment, or just a beautiful one?
- [Jewelry Gift Guide](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/jewelry-gift-guide): How to gift jewelry beautifully — occasions, designs, materials, sizing secrets, and why fine jewelry is one of the most precious investments you can make.
- [Oh the Places You'll Go](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/oh-the-places-youll-go): On waiting for inspiration, the ETA it never gives you, and why imperfect ideas are better than none at all.
- [The perfect custom piece: the guide](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/perfect-custom-piece-guide): From hex nut engagement rings to gold sun-and-bullet necklaces — a complete guide to commissioning a custom jewelry piece.
- [Nelly's Seven Design Tenets](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/seven-design-tenets): The principles Nelly has lived by as a jewelry designer and businesswoman — from wearable beauty to responsible craft and the quiet power of gold granulation.
- [Trends? Never heard of her](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/trends-never-heard-of-her): Trends move fast. Jewelry should not. How to choose pieces that outlive the scrolling cycle — and seven worth paying attention to right now.
- [What does your stone shape say about you?](https://nellycreativestudios.com/pages/journal/what-does-your-stone-shape-say): From the classic round diamond to old mine cuts — what your preferred stone shape reveals about your personality and style.
